name: @animastor/web-book-session
description: Book session identity contour for the Animastor web frontend. Single owner of the bookId/buildId identity signals, loadBook (the sanctioned identity mutator), the persisted localStorage session (write path + key contract), and the per-user stash/restore pair used by authStore on logout/login. The generation flow updates buildId through the controlled setGenerationBuildId adapter — one signal, two legal writers, no fork. No host stores, api/client, navigation, or playback dependencies.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
